description: The FOOD MENU on a restaurant’s or café’s Google Business Profile listing (only listings Google treats as a food business can have one; others are refused by name). action "get" (default): every menu, section and item with prices and dietary info, plus counts. action "update": menus — the FULL list, which REPLACES what is there (anything left out is removed). Each menu: {labels:[{displayName}], sections:[{labels:[{displayName}], items:[{labels:[{displayName, description}], attributes:{price:{currencyCode:"USD", units:"12", nanos:500000000}, dietaryRestriction:["VEGAN"], allergen:["DAIRY"], spiciness:"MILD"}}]}], cuisines:["ITALIAN"]}. Google’s limits are enforced, never trimmed: a label is at most 140 characters, a description 1,000. CALL update WITHOUT confirm FIRST: it compares the counts before and after and changes nothing; then confirm:true. Public and immediate. 0 credits.

confirm.description: update: true ONLY after the user approved the replacement

locationId.description: which listing (locations/…), from list_business_locations — only needed when more than one is shared with this profile

menus.description: update: the full list of menus, in Google’s FoodMenu shape

updateMask.description: update: optional Google field mask; omitted = the full menus replace
